layout.arrangement: A central rectangular plot area surrounded by a thin red border on a light gray canvas. X-axis ticks along the bottom (0, 10, 20, 30, 40). Y-axis ticks along the left (-10, 0, 10, 20, 30, 40). Dotted gray grid lines at each major tick. Seven colored point clusters of varying sizes and positions. A yellow circle with '43' in the top-right corner.

regions.name: chart area
regions.position: middle, spanning most of the slide width and height
regions.content: scatter plot with seven colored clusters and dotted grid

layout.hierarchy: The scatter plot dominates visually; axis tick labels are secondary; the slide number badge is a small accent.

visual_elements.description: Scatter plot showing seven clusters of points arranged in a roughly 3x3 grid layout over dotted background grids. Left column: blue cluster upper-left (around x 5-18, y 15-30), yellow cluster middle-left (around x 8-14, y 10-14), green cluster lower-left (around x 5-9, y 2-5). Middle column: red cluster top-middle (around x 18-25, y 20-25), magenta cluster center-bottom (around x 12-24, y 5-12). Right column: cyan cluster top-right (around x 28-36, y 15-28), black cluster bottom-right (around x 30-37, y 5-11). Dotted grid squares appear behind clusters in blue, cyan, magenta, yellow, green, and black. Axes run from 0 to 40 on x and -10 to 40 on y with dotted gridlines at intervals of 10.
Thin red rectangular border framing the plot area.
Yellow circular badge with black numeral 43.

typography_notes: Sans-serif font. Axis tick labels appear as small black numerals. Slide number '43' is black inside a yellow circle. No visible title or subtitle text.
animation_state: Static slide; no indication of partial builds or animations.
recreation_brief: 1. Create a blank slide with light gray background (#F0F0F0). 2. Insert a rectangular chart area centered on the slide with a thin red border (#CC0000). 3. Add X-axis labels 0, 10, 20, 30, 40 along the bottom and Y-axis labels -10, 0, 10, 20, 30, 40 along the left. 4. Draw dotted gray gridlines at each major tick both horizontally and vertically. 5. Plot seven scatter clusters: blue upper-left, yellow middle-left, green lower-left, red top-middle, magenta center-bottom, cyan top-right, black bottom-right, each with loose cloud shapes as described. 6. Add faint dotted colored grid squares behind each cluster region. 7. Place a yellow circle (#FFD700) in the top-right corner with the number 43 in black.
